messages:
Sylvia Chen: Heads-up — onboarding new retail tenant (tenant-rco) needs short-term L4 burst capacity in asia-southeast1 for load tests and canary. Requesting 6 L4 GPUs and 50 ephemeral external IPs for 48h. Also want A100 warm-fallback in us-west1 if capacity constrained. Can infra route this to a new project or reuse existing dev-gpu-project?

ops-bot: New quota request template: https://go/gcp-quota-form — include project id, use-case, start/end, accelerators, egress, IPs. Auto-check: network quotas ok for dev-gpu-project.

Sanjay Patel: @Sylvia what's the project id? If we create new project we'll need org-approval and billing scope. We prefer using dedicated 'burst-01' project to isolate quotas/costs.

Matt R.: Note cost: L4 preemptibles + 6 units ~ estimate $X/hr. Add to ticket that this is time-boxed 48h to justify burst quota. Also need to request 'VPC_PEERING egress' increase — current limit 10Gbps.

Leo Kim: For EIPs, Google charges for ephemeral external IPs when not attached. 50 ephemeral sounds high. Can we use Cloud NAT + private egress to reduce external IPs? If customer needs static IPs for partner allowlisting then ok.

Amy Torres: We can also try borrowing capacity from existing dedicated pool in us-west1 (redwood-dedicated-2). Fallback plan: route traffic to us-west1 A100s (3 units) with model-variant pinning. Need approval from security for cross-region data movement.

Sylvia Chen: Project id proposed: redwood-tenant-rco-001 (new). Use-case: load/canary tests with ephemeral models/embedding workloads. Start 1790002000 end 1790088400 (48h window).

Sanjay Patel: I'll open the org quota ticket. Quick checklist: project created? billing enabled? KMS key? VPC/subnet? service-usage enabled: compute.googleapis.com, compute.googleapis.com/accelerator, oslogin, iamcredentials.

ops-bot: Ticket created: Q-43912. Please paste the following snippet into ticket body:
```
Project: redwood-tenant-rco-001
Region: asia-southeast1
Accelerators: 6 L4 (n1-standard fallback to 3 A100 us-west1)
External IPs: 50 ephemeral (48h)
VPC egress increase: 20Gbps -> 50Gbps
Justification: canary/load tests for enterprise tenant
Window: 1790002000 - 1790088400
```

Leo Kim: Also set autoscaling with max pods per node so we don't exceed GPU quotas. Add quota for 'CPUS' and 'SSDs' if model files need local SSD.

Amy Torres: Security note: ensure Private Google Access + restricted VPC with logs. I'll ping compliance for cross-region fallback.

Matt R.: Thumbs up. @Sanjay please ask for expedited review — mention production-affecting customer onboarding. I'll approve budget for burst.
